assignments.essential_function: Review landing pages and forms for message match, clear value, calls to action, credible proof and friction, then prioritize improvements and tests.

review: Ordered page assessment includes traffic-source headline match, mobile/load/form friction, objection handling and alternatives. Recommendations distinguish test ideas from direct copy changes.
essential_function: Review landing pages and forms for message match, clear value, calls to action, credible proof and friction, then prioritize improvements and tests.
native_prerequisites: Page or rendered content, traffic source, conversion objective and available user/analytics evidence.
Keep authored .agents/.claude product-marketing context paths and native command names as working-project state; they are not bundled assets or newly registered command dispatch.

dependency_decisions: Only exact counted local-path/link adaptations plus standard name/licence/attribution headers and notices are permitted. Original expert guidance, workflow branches, native providers and project-state locations remain intact.
General related-skills lists are discovery suggestions, not implied bundled workflows.
No source script is executed or transformed. Retained provider guide CLI links are real transitive dependencies, unlike the optional full tools registry.

excluded_files.reason: Development evaluation fixture, not read/invoked by the selected workflow.

research_pin_note: The installed source pin remains explicit above; already clean licensed packages may retain their earlier reviewed pin rather than mix historical support files.
source_review_limitations: Qualitative conversion diagnosis, not proof of causal lift or statistical experiment analysis. Related ab-testing is discovery context and is not approved in this kit.
Original instructions are unchanged; actual credentials, publishing authority and deployment compatibility are not verified.
Original shared tools and relative support hierarchy must be preserved; a single-folder skills.sh copy can omit them (documented in upstream issue #524).
source_review_limitations_scope: Original-source research observations retained verbatim. Statements about unchanged instructions or upstream folder layout describe the reviewed originals; this package applies only the recorded metadata/name/path adaptations. Current packaging decisions and runtime requirements are recorded separately.
